item.title: Closed-Form Dynamics of a Collectively Pumped Emitter Ensemble
item.description: arXiv:2610.91665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We follow an ensemble of $N$ made-up two-level emitters that decay together at rate $Γ$ while a pump drives them at rate $R$, and give the whole evolution in closed form.
item.dc:creator: Mira Okafor, Nico Weißler, Tomas Reyes, Hanna J. Weller, Pavel Ondrej, Ines Duarte, Kofi Mensah

item.title: Telling weak signals apart at exceptional points of open systems
item.description: arXiv:2610.91660v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Do exceptional points make a weak perturbation easier to tell apart, for example in an optical fibre? We compare invented detectors near and away from them.
item.dc:creator: Jane Doe, John Smith

item.title: Adiabatic state transfer with $\mathcal{O}(1)$ overhead in photonic lattices
item.description: arXiv:2609.01234v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that adiabatic passage in coupled waveguide arrays transfers light with constant overhead.
item.dc:creator: Ada Lovelace
